messages:
Sam (marketing): Hey team — prepping the webinar demo. Need a verified artifact bundle we can link from the deck: per-run CSVs, aggregated KPIs, warm vs cold profiles, and a 1-page runbook. Can you take this on?

Mei (marketing): Prefer a single zip with a manifest and a short README that includes the exact commands we can paste into the blog. Also add one line: how we measured embedding latency.

Jonah (eng-runtime): We can do it. Two questions: (a) which model variants should we include? (b) what pass/fail thresholds should marketing expect?

Sam (marketing): Include fp16 baseline + int8-quant. Optionally a smaller 3B for demo fallback. KPIs: gen median < 300ms for <=64 tokens, embedding p50 < 35ms. Tag any misses as FAIL in summary.

bench-bot: queued job 4902 - ingesting payloads from drive:/marketing/webinar-june/payloads.jsonl

Priya (eng-runtime): We'll run on staging dedicated nodes with batch sizes 1 and 2, and run warmup=0 and warmup=8. Deliverables: artifacts.zip with runs/*.csv, summary.csv (p50/p90/p95/p99), manifest.txt, runbook.md. ETA Monday noon.

Sam (marketing): Monday noon works. Important: include a random 15% holdout and mark it in manifest.txt for SRE verification. No manual sample cherry-picking.

Jonah (eng-runtime): Understood. We'll bake the holdout selection into the runner and include the RNG seed in manifest. Also will capture per-shard latency breakdowns.

Mei (marketing): Can we get a small human-readable table for the slide that calls out: model, variant, median_gen_ms, median_embed_ms, cold_95_ms?

Priya (eng-runtime): Yes. We'll add a slide-ready CSV summary and a small JSON snippet for programmatic checks.

Sam (marketing): Also add a short note in runbook about traffic profile used (token distribution). We'll need the exact command you ran.

Jonah (eng-runtime): Example command we'll include (edited for public):

```
benchctl run --model redwood-7b-v2 --variant int8 --batch 1 --warmup 8 --payloads payloads.jsonl --out runs/warm_int8.csv
```

bench-bot: job 4902 -> ingest complete: 60 payloads, artifacts staged at /artifacts/4902

Priya (eng-runtime): Smoke started. We'll test kernel variants, kv-cache on/off, and also measure coldstart (first request) separately. If variance is >30% p95/p50 we'll do a second sweep with longer warmup.

Sam (marketing): If a rerun happens, please keep both the original and the rerun artifacts. We'll label them clearly in the README.

Jonah (eng-runtime): Makes sense. Posting small sample excerpt of runs CSV: 

```
req,variant,warmup,total_ms,model_ms,tokens
001,fp16,false,420,405,40
002,int8,true,190,176,28
003,int8,false,1150,1135,1400
```

Mei (marketing): This looks good. When you upload the zip, ping #marketing and paste a short checklist we can tick off (artifacts present, manifest includes seed, pass/fail table, runbook).

Priya (eng-runtime): Will do. We'll also include the raw traces tar.gz and a note about which kernel was used for int8. ETA: uploading by 11:30.

Sam (marketing): Thanks — we'll hold off final slide copy until we see the summary. :thumbsup:
